messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — Medicore just asked to expand the pilot: add semantic embeddings + a reranker for Q&A, and they require BYOK (their AWS KMS). This is a scope change.

mia_solutions: Got it. Do they want us to provide embeddings or host their index? what's the expected UX?

sam_sales: They want Redwood to manage indexing + rerank end-to-end in pilot. They said speed matters for clinician workflows.

devon_se: That means two technical deltas: (1) embed generation+indexing pipeline; (2) cross-encoder reranker for top-k. Reranker at p99 < 200ms needs GPU, otherwise expect 1-2s on CPU. Also BYOK touches deployment bootstrap.

alexa_security: For BYOK we need their KMS key ARN and a cross-account role. Also confirm whether they need HSM-backed keys and rotation cadence. BYOK implies we never export key material.

sam_sales: Medicore preferrs BYOK in their AWS acct and says they can expedite IAM changes if we provide exact ARNs.

devon_se: Rough cost/timing ballpark if added to hosted pilot (assuming 100k tokens/day gen load):
- embeddings: modest compute or billed via embeddings endpoint (~+10% token cost if we keep them on hosted)
- reranker: reserve 1-2 A10-class GPUs for steady p99; ops delta ~$3.5k-5k/mo depending on commit
- integration + perf testing: ~10 business days optimistic, plus KMS approvals

mia_solutions: Medicore wants results in ~3 weeks. Feasible?

devon_se: Tight but doable if KMS and role are approved quickly. Proposed fast-track plan:
1) select embed + rerank models (1 day)
2) send IAM/KMS schema to customer & get role/ARNs (1-3 days customer action)
3) deploy pilot infra + BYOK bootstrap (2-3 days)
4) perf runs + small eval (2-3 days)
Total optimistic 8-12 business days; add buffer for approvals.

alexa_security: I'll post the minimal ACL/ARN list and a short BYOK checklist in this thread. Note: need an IGA ticket on their side for cross-account trust.

sam_sales: Please include exact role name and policy snippet. Customer said they can create roles if we provide trust.json & policy.json.

alexa_security: Sending snippet now. Also: clarify whether BYOK only for storage/encryption or also for signing requests?

sam_sales: BYOK for all persisted customer data in the pilot; standard service signing remains Redwood-managed.

mia_solutions: For success metrics I propose we rebaseline pilot to include:
- embedding recall@10 >= 0.75 on a 500-query eval subset
- rerank MRR >= 0.6 (initial)
- end-to-end 95p latency <= 600ms for clinician queries
- availability >= 99.5%
- cost per query cap (TBD with finance)

sam_sales: Medicore agrees to a reduced eval set (500) to meet timeline but wants the plan to include a fuller eval after pilot.

devon_se: We can do a 500-query smoke eval in ~2 days. Full eval (5k) later for final acceptance. Also, fallback plan: if GPU cost is a blocker, we can switch to ANN index + light scorer for production — much cheaper but may reduce MRR. Add that as rollout option.

mia_solutions: Pricing note: adding rerank changes bill shape. I'll prepare two pricing options:
A) Redwood-hosted end-to-end (includes GPUs, indexing) — turnkey, higher monthly cost
B) Hybrid: customer hosts embeddings/index; Redwood handles generation + rerank — lower host cost but more ops on customer side

sam_sales: Good. Devon/ops: do we have spare GPU capacity that can be reserved short-term?

devon_se: We can allocate burst GPUs but need a PO/reservation. Ops estimate: reserve 2 A10-equivalent for peaks; cost ~ $4k/mo.

alexa_security: Reminder: hybrid option still requires BYOK for persisted data. Update security questionnaire accordingly.

sam_sales: Action items:
- devon_se: post perf run config and quick deploy steps + example IAM/KMS commands (today)
- alexa_security: post exact ARNs + BYOK checklist to share with customer (today)
- mia_solutions: publish the 500-query eval subset and success criteria doc (tomorrow)
- sam_sales: send pricing options A/B + recommended legal addendum for BYOK (EOD)

customer_bot (Medicore): Thanks, team. Can you also confirm whether we can substitute reranker later with ANN + cheap scorer if cost becomes an obstacle?

devon_se: Yes — architecture supports swapping to ANN + lightweight scorer as a fallback. Document tradeoffs in rollout plan.

sam_sales: Meeting set to rebaseline tomorrow 11am PT. I'll include pricing and BYOK addendum in the invite. :calendar:

mia_solutions: I'll drop the eval prompt list in #sales-docs and tag reviewers. :white_check_mark:
